findings.description: Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-01 (Decree Nisi / interlocutory, not final) undetected. Document explicitly states decree_type 'Interlocutory Decree Nisi', marital_status 'Married (Decree Nisi Conditional)', and narrative warns 'This Decree Nisi does not finalize the dissolution... until a Decree Absolute is formally granted.' Worker returned generic policy only.

basis[] asserts 'declared marital status is divorced', contradicting the document which states marital_status 'Married (Decree Nisi Conditional)'. Indicates the worker did not read document fields and invented civil status.
Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-01 (Decree Nisi, not final Decree Absolute) undetected. Scanned sibling of 1fd061; same Decree Nisi / conditional-marital-status content ignored.

Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-02 (uncertified copy) undetected. Document shows court_seal_present False, judicial_signature N/A, certified_copy_status 'Uncertified Photocopy', issuing_authority 'Unverified Court Printout', with narrative 'Uncertified copies are not valid legal proof of divorce.' Worker gave generic policy.
Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-02 (uncertified copy, no seal/signature) undetected. Scanned sibling of 4b1062; identical authenticity defects ignored.

Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-03 (untranslated foreign decree) undetected. Document is Spanish (document_language Spanish, translation_certified False, translator_affidavit null), narrative confirms no certified English translation. Worker did not flag the translation non-compliance.
Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-03 (untranslated Spanish decree) undetected. Scanned sibling of d14bb2; missing certified translation ignored.

Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-04 (invalid jurisdiction / no residency nexus) undetected. Document shows Dominican Republic ex parte decree, spouse_residency_duration '0 days', foreign_divorce_validity 'Invalid - Lacks Residency Nexus', narrative 'JURISDICTIONAL DEFECT... rendering the dissolution legally invalid.' Worker returned generic policy.
Injected defect PFL-DIVORCE-04 (foreign divorce lacking residency nexus) undetected. Scanned sibling of 88f49a; invalid jurisdiction defect ignored.

Clean case (Final Decree Absolute, certified, valid US decree). No defect present and none falsely flagged; however the worker rendered no verdict, only a generic policy answer, so the pass is incidental rather than evidence-based.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the agent to move beyond policy retrieval and emit a per-document verdict (meets_requirements|defective) derived from the document's own fields. Mandate explicit checks of: decree_type/marital_status (reject Decree Nisi / interlocutory / conditional statuses — require Final Decree Absolute), certified_copy_status + court_seal_present + judicial_signature (reject uncertified/no-seal/no-signature printouts), document_language + translation_certified + translator_affidavit (reject non-English/French decrees lacking certified translation), and jurisdiction_country + spouse_residency_duration + foreign_divorce_validity (reject foreign decrees with no 12-month residency nexus).

Add a directive that document-review questions phrased as 'what document is required' must still trigger a full defect scan of the attached PDF, not a generic corpus answer. The agent must read every rendered field and the narrative/notes page, and surface any field or narrative that self-declares invalidity (e.g., 'does not finalize', 'Uncertified copies are not valid', 'JURISDICTIONAL DEFECT') as a blocking finding placed in claims/prose, keeping applicant PII confined to basis[].

rationale: The Gemini 3.6 Flash worker systematically treated all 10 cases as a policy-retrieval question ('what document is required when divorced') and returned a near-identical generic answer citing the completeness-check corpus, without ever evaluating the attached documents. Consequently every one of the 8 injected defects (Decree Nisi x2, uncertified copy x2, untranslated Spanish decree x2, invalid Dominican jurisdiction x2) went undetected — defect_recall 0.0 across all defective cases, despite each PDF explicitly self-declaring its defect in both fields and narrative notes. The 2 clean sibling cases (90c896, 360b46) 'pass' only incidentally since no defect existed and none was falsely raised. Citation grounding is acceptable: the corpus quote about the legal separation agreement and the fuller bullet quote in 88f49a are consistent with genuine IRCC guidance, so grounding_accuracy and citation_exactness remain high — the exception is 1fd061, whose basis falsely asserts 'marital status is divorced' when the document states 'Married (Decree Nisi Conditional)', an invented civil status. PII containment is clean throughout: claims/prose contain no applicant names, case numbers, or dates, and applicant facts are confined to basis[]. No ground-truth leakage is present, so blind_input_compliance is full. The dominant, critical failure is defect detection: the worker must be forced to analyze document fields and render evidence-based verdicts rather than emit boilerplate requirements.
